description: This file appears to be a script for static code analysis, performing lint-like checks on source files within a project. It reads source code, parses it using TypeScript compiler API, and identifies specific API usage violations related to account-scoping and legacy function calls.

methods.name: isUndefinedLikeExpression
methods.description: Checks if a given AST node represents an 'undefined' or 'null' expression.

methods.name: hasRequiredAccountIdProperty
methods.description: Determines if an object literal AST node contains an 'accountId' property with a valid initializer.

methods.name: findViolations
methods.description: Parses source content to identify specific code pattern violations related to API usage.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that runs the violation detection over the files.
